messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

context.description: The context or scenario in which the question is being asked, providing additional information to the user.

message.content:
Below is a list of the long‑weekend holidays that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
For each entry I’ve included:

| Holiday | Date(s) in 2023 | Long‑weekend span | Province(s) where the holiday is observed (if it’s a provincial holiday) |
|---------|-----------------|-------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Jan 1 (​Sunday) – observed Mon 2 | **Jan 1 – 3** (Sun‑Tue) | All provinces & territories |
| **Family Day** (Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba) | Feb 20 (Monday) | **Feb 18 – 20** (Sat‑Mon) | Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba |
| **BC Day of Celebration** (British Columbia) | Feb 6 (Monday) | **Feb 4 – 6** (Sat‑Mon) | British Columbia |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 (Friday) | **Apr 7 – 9** (Fri‑Sun) | All provinces & territories |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Monday) | **May 20 – 22** (Sat‑Mon) | All provinces & territories |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1 (​Saturday) – observed Mon 3 | **Jul 1 – 3** (Sat‑Mon) | All provinces & territories |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 (Monday) | **Sep 2 – 4** (Sat‑Mon) | All provinces & territories |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 (Monday) | **Oct 7 – 9** (Sat‑Mon) | All provinces & territories |
| **Remembrance Day** | Nov 11 (​Friday) | **Nov 11 – 13** (Fri‑Sun) | All provinces & territories |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 (​Monday) | **Dec 23 – 25** (Sat‑Mon) | All provinces & territories |
| **Boxing Day** | Dec 26 (Tuesday) – observed Mon 27 | **Dec 26 – 28** (Tue‑Thu) | All provinces & territories |

### How to use this list

* **Long‑weekend span** shows the full stretch of days that give you a three‑day break (including the weekend).  
* If you’re planning trips that cross provincial borders, note that some holidays (e.g., Family Day) only apply in certain provinces.  
* For holidays that fall on a weekend (e.g., Canada Day on Saturday), the “observed” day is the following Monday, which is what creates the long weekend.

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app or use the dates directly to schedule your long‑weekend getaways!
